text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0822 CDT.

CANOLA - C$1.00 to C$2.00 a tonne higher on CBOT calls with new crop November expected to post the largest and most sustained gains as old crop follows. Technical resistance seen in the July at $401, then $404. July WCE futures crush margin rose to +1.93 Tuesday from +0.97 Monday. Canada's dollar opened flat at C$1.3864 versus the U.S. dollar, fell to 81.73 yen, rose to 1.2450 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 up on allied markets.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 up on CBOT corn calls. Alberta Wheat Pool was expected to continue selling barley spreads.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 up on CBOT corn and wheat calls.
PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 up on CBOT soymeal calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
